title: Who Gets to Tell Isola's History?

collection.credit:
CREDITS: Lorsieab2 proposed making the full competition suite available in
VV1, VV2, VV3, VV4 and VV5, rewriting each to reflect its setting, and
specifically proposed VV5 Heathen/Isolan competitors and judges with political
tensions. The original VV2 Cooking Contest's premise, mechanics and text are
by Lorsieab2. The game-specific adaptations, fresh dialogue, branching,
political plots and integration notes below are written by ChatGPT.
Existing universal competitions and their previous credits remain intact.

contest.text: An Isolan storyteller and a player-tribe devotee recite accounts of the same historical event. The dates and heroes differ. A famously merciless keeper of verses corrects both, then accidentally misquotes a sacred line and becomes the laughingstock of the festival.
contest.name: Who Gets to Tell Isola's History?

choices.label: Compare sources and publicly identify what is known and uncertain.
Preserve two attributed versions in the village record.
Compose a new shared song, while allowing each community to keep its own older verses.

d.text: A comic misrecitation may become a festival legend, but it must not silently overwrite sacred history.
